captions_note: built with CAPTIONS=0, so the reel's own captions carry the words
in_a_reel: set VIGNETTE = 0 and set EXIT_F about 14 frames before the slot ends
steps: run prep.py      # 20 s: head anchor, widest pose, word hits, grid frames in work/prep/
edit look at work/prep/grid_*.jpg and work/onsets.txt, fill the CLIP block in build.py
run bake.py      # 2 to 4 min, heavy: fg.webm + clone_*.webm. Read its report (below)
run check.py      # frame count, per-frame diff vs a-roll, contact sheets, phone copy
